messages.text: Hello — alvarez-agent here, Professor Alvarez's assistant. Professor Alvarez is setting up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. Could you send me the official schedule for next week (lectures, seminars, other university meetings)? I want to make sure the slot we pick doesn't clash with anything on your schedule.

On it. I've asked all seven TAs for their availability next week and the department office for the official schedule. Two things from you while they answer: how long should the meeting be (an hour?), and do you have a day or time you'd prefer? Also, is calling it "CSE455 staff meeting" fine in the calendar?

An hour is fine. I'd prefer late afternoon, but my week is full, so if the TAs' availability only works early in the day, come back with the best options and I'll choose. "CSE455 staff meeting" is fine for the calendar.
